data.description: A live call connected; listen for utterances.
A new utterance arrived; wait for a short pause in speech before deciding.
More speech: replace the queued utterance and restart the quiet period.
The person stopped the controller; the queued utterance is dropped.
Speech while deciding is kept for the next decision; the decision in flight is not cancelled.
The person stopped the controller: the runtime is asked to cancel planning, the request is aborted and queued speech is dropped.
The controller held: nothing in the document changes.

The controller chose one host action. Actions:
- recordAction: keep it in `current` and the log
- announceAction: hand it to the app (controller.hostAction) for the document machine
The decision failed (unroutable model, runtime error, timeout): logged and shown; the call continues.

The action ran (or could not). Actions:
- recordResult: log applied/failed with the render outcome and refresh the host context
- announceFact: tell the app (controller.fact) so Live hears what changed
Speech during execution is kept for the next decision.
Stop drops queued speech; the local edit in progress still completes and is receipted.
Speech during the receipt is kept for the next decision.
Stop drops queued speech.
Recorded.
The runtime did not record the receipt; the document change stands and the person is told.
Speech arrived while the last decision ran.
Nothing queued.
Stored preferences arrived with the design model chosen last time.
The header chose another design model; the next decision uses it. Text and voice are unaffected.
The live call ended: forget queued speech and abandon a decision in flight (its planning is cancelled at the runtime).
No live call; nothing to decide on.
Waiting for the person to say something.
The quiet period after an utterance; more speech restarts it so fragments of one thought become one decision.
One silent decision on a fresh runtime session. Entry consumes the queued utterance into `current` and logs it. Invokes decider (POST /api/chat, output_mode host_tools).
The document machine is performing the action; the result comes back through the app with fresh host context.
Returning the action's result to the decision session so the runtime records it. Invokes receipt.
Transient: decide again on speech that arrived meanwhile, or go back to listening.
